title: CNG new productive forces report2025
publisher: Beijing Gamma New Media Culture Communication Co., Ltd. / Gamma Data (CNG)
methodology: Personnel scale of major listed game companies, as printed. The report supplies no constituent list, count, selection rule, domestic versus overseas allocation, game-segment allocation, or contractor treatment.
assessment: Contextual sample only. It must not be plotted as Chinese national or domestic game-only employment, and the annual values must not be combined with H1 observations.
access_status: PDF independently inspected in prior research batch
next_step: Find disclosed panel constituents before treating as national or longitudinal domestic measure.

title: NBS government-series scope check
publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China
methodology: Game activities split across classes; published groups broader than games.
assessment: The 2018 economic-census release gives 9.951m workers for the entire information-transmission/software/IT-service division, including 1.443m in internet and related services and 6.762m in software/IT services, but not a game-only total. The official culture-new-form grouping combines 16 small industries.
access_status: Research worker inspected; result preserved in findings.md
next_step: Seek detailed-class employment table, not broad IT/culture aggregate.

title: CNG2026 listed-company release
methodology: For the 2026 report's own panels, major listed game companies are Chinese listed companies in 2025 game-revenue TOP50 whose 2025 game revenue exceeds 30% of total revenue; historical chart coverage is restricted to companies disclosing values in all corresponding periods.
assessment: No personnel/headcount aggregate or historical workforce chart found in the 2026 release or in the inspected 2024 and 2025 full listed/non-listed company reports. No new observations proposed. This definition is not printed in the 2025 new-productive-forces report and therefore cannot be assumed to define its p. 8 personnel chart.
next_step: Do not retroactively assign this panel rule to a different report.
